method: Horse-by-horse handicap estimate using current exposed class, Group 1 record, staying profile, likely Australian handicap treatment, historical Melbourne Cup compression, age/sex context and Northern Hemisphere three-year-old treatment. These are estimates, not official weights. The working board is restricted to official Melbourne Cup nominees.
